items.description: Leak detection and opening of the bathroom wall next to the washbasin
items.rationale: Covered under 2.1: locating the leak and opening the wall to reach it. Reference Case 21 shows similar work (leak detection call-out, opening wall) is indemnified at >=229 EUR for call-out and >=449 EUR for pinpointing, but this is a combined line for 2 hours, so a moderate estimate is appropriate.

items.description: Replacement of split copper supply pipe section, 15 mm, incl. fittings
items.rationale: Covered under 2.2: repairing the fractured pipe. Reference Case 18 (copper pipe repair, incl. fittings) was indemnified at >=221 EUR for a similar flat rate; this is a single section, so a similar value applies.

items.description: Closing the wall opening, re-plastering and re-tiling approx. 0.2 m2
items.rationale: Covered under 2.3: restoring the damaged plaster and tiles to their previous condition. Reference Case 21 (final site cleaning, transition pieces, and similar restoration) shows values between 49 and 85 EUR for small areas; for 0.2 m2, a moderate estimate is justified.

items.description: Annual service and descaling of the gas boiler in the hallway
items.rationale: Explicitly excluded by 3.1: maintenance, servicing or descaling of installations, even if carried out during the same visit. Not related to the insured damage.
